name: batch
description: Execute batch operations on multiple files in parallel. Automatically discovers files, splits into chunks, and processes with parallel worker agents. Use `/batch` followed by operation and file pattern. For many independent single-turn transforms (translate/rewrite/extract each file into a new file) that can wait minutes to hours, you may suggest the user type `/batch-api` themselves for the half-price asynchronous Batch API — you cannot invoke it, and it is not suited to in-place edits or tasks
author: QwenLM
